name: Geeste (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and green with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Geeste (a white wavy bend, a drilling rig and a wheel on green).
history: Municipal flag of Geeste; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Geeste arms — wavy bend, drilling rig and wheel on green
